about_short_description.short_description: Hive Health provides HMO plans for SMEs, helping employees and their families access healthcare through a network of hospitals and doctors.

product.name: HMO Health Plans for SMEs
product.description: Comprehensive health maintenance organization (HMO) plans designed for small and medium enterprises in the Philippines, providing coverage for employees and their dependents.

product.name: Hive Member Portal
product.description: A digital platform for members to access healthcare services, manage authorizations, and view medical records.

product.name: Hive HR Dashboard
product.description: An online dashboard for HR teams to manage employee health benefits and monitor utilization.

product.name: Teleconsultation Services
product.description: Video consultations with in-house primary care, specialist, and mental health doctors.

product.name: Mental Health Coverage
product.description: Coverage for mental health consultations with licensed mental health professionals via video.

product.name: Maternity Benefits
product.description: Cash assistance for normal delivery, C-section, and miscarriage for female members.
